notes: A TechLog icon on Fenix's own EFB tablet in the cockpit, and on a tablet or phone on your network at your PC's address, port 8083 (Settings → Fenix and the sim).
Engine oil quantity, pressure and temperature are read from Fenix V3, with new limits for oil temperature, oil pressure, engine vibration and cabin overpressure.
The Status page shows what Fenix reports: hydraulics, batteries, EPR and N1 limits, cabin pressure and bleed.
Easier to use on the sim's tablet: no more squares in place of symbols, drag to scroll, and drawings and layouts that fit at any text size.
